bullets.title: Contact
bullets.creator: Metsa
bullets.note: . I’ve been waiting a long time for this one. Here’s the description, edited for length: This album is a compilation of ceremonial plant medicine songs called ikaros, some of which are traditional and some of which are reinterpretations informed by decades of practice. This artist supports a number of indigenous communities and causes, so I bought the album on Bandcamp, which allows you to donate above the low album price. I gave $100, but you can get the entire album for $9.99. [Get a taste of it here](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvh3zldxco/x4tph6hzn2m8dq/aHR0cHM6Ly9tZXRzYW11c2ljLmJhbmRjYW1wLmNvbS9hbGJ1bS9jb250YWN0). I love all the tracks, but I’m paying closest attention to [Urkututu (track #5)](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvh3zldxco/6mceh8hwpr4v69/aHR0cHM6Ly9tZXRzYW11c2ljLmJhbmRjYW1wLmNvbS9hbGJ1bS9jb250YWN0) at the moment.

bullets.title: The MeatEater Podcast — Ep. 166: Hunting With Teeth
bullets.note: This is an uber-intelligent conversation that explores a lot of nuance. It spans biology, conservation, and uncomfortable realities that we must learn to navigate. Here’s the description: “Steven Rinella ([@stevenrinella](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvh3zldxco/zdcghnh7o6z983/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9zdGV2ZW5yaW5lbGxhLw==)) talks with Diane Boyd and Janis Putelis ([@janis_putelis](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvh3zldxco/xqsph6hzn2m8le/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qYW5pc19wdXRlbGlzLz9obD1lbg==)). Subjects discussed: Cyclone fences; swapping a motorcycle for a first wolf experience; Wolf rendezvous sites and snagging a wolf in a blind set; wolves killing wolves; wolves and border security; the myth of the super-wolf; did the wolf reintroduction need to happen?; how old is an old wolf; what, if anything, should Colorado do about wolves; should we be hunting and trapping wolves; the emotional and monetary value of wolves; would you do anything differently; and more.” Thanks to reader John Hoyt for [recommending this to me](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvh3zldxco/kpamh6he8wpg36/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9Qd2Rya2VnL3N0YXR1cy8xMTYyMzQ1NDg0NDczNjU5Mzky) on Twitter.
